name: Flash
effect: Blink teleport forward a short distance. Cannot use while rooted or grounded.

name: Ignite
effect: Burns target for true damage over 5s, applies Grievous Wounds (reduces healing 50%)

name: Exhaust
effect: Slows enemy and reduces their damage output by 40% for 2.5s
bestOn: Supports vs assassins, ADCs for self-peel

name: Smite
effect: Deals true damage to monsters/minions. Upgrades at 4 smites. Required for jungle.

name: Barrier
effect: Shields yourself for 2.5s. Blocks incoming damage.
bestOn: ADCs, mid laners vs burst assassins

name: Heal
effect: Heals you and nearby ally, grants brief movement speed boost

name: Teleport
effect: Channel to teleport to an allied structure or ward after 3.5s

name: Ghost
effect: Gain ramping movement speed for 6s. Extends on takedowns.

name: Cleanse
effect: Removes all CC effects from yourself

name: Clarity
effect: Restores mana for you and nearby allies
